_readme: Copy this file to runtime/career-ops/watchlist/company-watchlist.json and put your company names in `companies`. An empty list is valid: the watchlist layer's identity, careers/ATS resolution, query families, funnel route and brief section all run with zero companies, so adding names later is a data edit only. The runtime copy is git-ignored because it names your target companies.

_row_schema.company: required — the company name as you write it
_row_schema.careers_url: optional — the official careers/ATS URL, when you already know it
_row_schema.aliases: optional — other spellings/legal names that ARE the same company
_row_schema.notes: optional — free text; recorded as provenance, never parsed for facts
_row_schema.regions: optional — region codes this company matters in (default: the run's region)
_row_schema.role_families: optional — override the role families researched for this company

_example_row.company: NOT A COMPANY — example shape only, not read by the loader
_example_row.notes: why this company matters to me (recorded as provenance only)
